removals.intro: Taking a project out of Value Bridge needs two platform admins: one asks, a different one approves, and the operator runs it at least 24 hours later. While a request is open the project cannot be changed.
removals.fewAdmins: Only {n} live platform admin. Every removal needs two: add a second platform admin before any project can be archived or deleted.
removals.due.title: Due for archiving
removals.due.none: No project is due. A project comes due two years after it was closed.
removals.backlog.title: Archive files still owed
removals.backlog.none: Every frozen baseline has its archive file.

removals.new.title: Request a removal

removals.confirm.label: Type {expected} to confirm
removals.confirm.requestBody: From the moment you confirm, nobody can change this project until the request is cancelled or carried out.
removals.confirm.deleteArchiveBody: The project left Value Bridge when it was archived. Once a second platform admin approves and the operator runs it, the project's keys are destroyed and every archive file of it becomes unreadable for good.
removals.confirm.approveBody: Requested by {who} on {when}. Reason: {reason}. The operator can carry it out 24 hours after your approval; it cannot be undone.
removals.confirm.cancelBody: The project can be changed again at once.
